note: Village-run campground on the southeast side of Wilton, beside the village pool and ball fields and a few blocks from the Elroy-Sparta State Trail. The RV sites ring a loop by the restrooms; the tent-only sites run along the Kickapoo River, a small stream here. The village's rate graphic numbers the electric sites 1-32 and tent sites 33-50, but its 2026 map shows 27 RV sites. --Claude
summary: Village page and its graphics read: $35 RV/electric (1 tent incl., +$5 extra tent), tent-only $20; 2026 map 27 RV sites (50A #5-14, 30A others) + 18 tent sites = 45; open May 1 - Nov 1; showers, laundry, dump, WiFi, drinking water. Stored riverview fails: the Kickapoo is a ~5-6 m creek 45-110 m from the RV sites beyond the tent lawn -> not waterfront lead.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD riverview -> not waterfront: the Kickapoo at the campground is a ~5-6 m meandering stream (creek-size, Esri imagery 2026-11-16 at 43.8105,-90.5245), in a brushy channel 45-110 m from the RV loop's outer sites, with the tent-only sites (#28-#45, on the village's 2026 map 'along' the river) and a crop field between. No RV site is near it and no photo shows it from an RV site.

SITE NUMBERING CONFLICT on the village's own page: the rate graphic says 'Electrical Sites 1-32' and 'Sites 33-50' tent only (50 sites), the '2026 Campground Map' shows RV #1-#27 and tent #28-#45 (45). sites.count 45 from the map.

BOOKING: the page gives no reservation method; 'PAY ONLINE HERE' goes to an allpaid.com payment form. The stored note's 'primarily FCFS with self-pay box' has no source on the page; booking left unset.
PIN 43.8120,-90.5253 sits at the parking lot beside the RV loop (~35 m from its centre ~43.8122,-90.5257): fine.

RULES worth knowing: 'Campers must provide a proof of Liability Insurance and auto ID card'; golf carts/ATVs/UTVs allowed on campground roads under the campground terms (no trail system, ordinary municipal campground).
